name: Pathfinding
description: Find paths around obstacles, and optionally move along them.

conditions.description: Triggered after 'Find path' when a path successfully found.
Triggered after 'Find path' when no path could be found.
Test if a cell in the pathfinding map is marked as an obstacle.

cell-x.name: Cell X
cell-x.desc: The horizontal cell to test if an obstacle (in cells, rather than layout co-ordinates).

cell-y.name: Cell Y
cell-y.desc: The vertical cell to test if an obstacle (in cells, rather than layout co-ordinates).

conditions.description: True if the object is currently searching for a path.
True if the object is currently moving along a found path.
Triggered when moving along path and arrived at destination.
Compare the current movement speed of the object.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.desc: How to compare the current movement speed.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The speed to compare to, in pixels per second.

conditions.description: True if diagonal movement across cells is currently enabled.
Test if the behavior is enabled.

actions.description: Start looking for a path to a destination, later triggering 'On path found' or 'On failed to find path'.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate to find a path to.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate to find a path to.

actions.description: Enable or disable the behavior.

set.name: Set
set.desc: Whether to enable or disable the behavior.

actions.description: (Slow) Check every cell to determine if it is an obstacle again, in case obstacles have moved or changed. Completes next tick.
When using custom obstacles, add a family or object as an obstacle.

obstacle.name: Obstacle
obstacle.desc: Choose a family or object to use as obstacles in the pathfinding map.

actions.description: Clear the added custom obstacles.
Set the basic cost for moving to an adjacent cell, which affects the relative effect of other costs.

move-cost.name: Move cost
move-cost.desc: The basic cost to move to an adjacent cell while calculating a path.

actions.description: Increase the path cost for travelling over an object (e.g. to simulate rough terrain).

object.name: Object
object.desc: Choose an object to increase pathfinding cost.

cost.name: Cost
cost.desc: The additional cost to travel over this object. Note normal costs are 10 and 14 for horizontal/diagonal movement respectively.

actions.description: Clear any additional path cost that was previously added.
Regenerate just a rectangular portion of the obstacle map in layout co-ordinates. Completes next tick.

start-x.name: Start X
start-x.desc: Start X co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.

start-y.name: Start Y
start-y.desc: Start Y co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.

end-x.name: End X
end-x.desc: End X co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.

end-y.name: End Y
end-y.desc: End Y co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.

actions.description: Regenerate just a rectangular portion of the obstacle map from an object's bounding box. Completes next tick.

object.name: Object
object.desc: An object whose bounding box will determine a rectangular portion of the obstacle map to regenerate.

actions.display-text: {my}: Start path group (base cost [i]{0}[/i], cell spread [i]{1}[/i], max workers [i]{2}[/i])
actions.description: Spread out paths by adding a temporary extra cost around found paths in the same group.

base-cost.name: Base cost
base-cost.desc: The extra cost to add around found paths, which is multiplied depending on the number of workers used.

cell-spread.name: Cell spread
cell-spread.desc: The number of cells around the found path to increase cost for. Prefer to use an odd number.

max-workers.name: Max workers
max-workers.desc: The maximum number of worker threads to distribute paths across for this group. Each worker tracks costs separately.

actions.description: End a path group, restoring normal pathfinding.
Start moving along a found path after the 'On path found' trigger.
Stop moving along a path.
Set the maximum speed for moving along paths.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The maximum speed to set, in pixels per second.

actions.description: Set the acceleration for moving along paths.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: The acceleration to set, in pixels per second per second.

actions.description: Set the deceleration for moving along paths.

deceleration.name: Deceleration
deceleration.desc: The deceleration to set, in pixels per second per second.

actions.display-text: Set {my} rotate speed to [i]{0}[/i] degrees per second
actions.description: Set the turn speed for moving along paths.

rotate-speed.name: Rotate speed
rotate-speed.desc: The turn speed to set, in degrees per second.

actions.description: Enable or disable diagonal movement across cells.

diagonals.name: Diagonals
diagonals.desc: Whether to enable or disable diagonal movement across cells.

actions.description: Set where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.

mode.name: Direct movement
mode.desc: Where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.

actions.description: Set the current speed for moving along paths.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The speed to set, in pixels per second.

expressions.description: The number of nodes along a found path.
The X co-ordinate of a node at an index.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of node in path.

expressions.description: The Y co-ordinate of a node at an index.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of node in path.

expressions.description: The current angle of motion along a path, in degrees.
The current zero-based node index moving towards.
The current speed in pixels per second while moving.
The current maximum speed in pixels per second.
The current acceleration in pixels per second per second.
The current deceleration in pixels per second per second.
The current maximum turn speed in degrees per second.

cell-size.name: Cell size
cell-size.desc: The size of cells for pathfinding. Smaller sizes will use more CPU.

cell-border.name: Cell border
cell-border.desc: Additional size to detect obstacles. Prevents paths very close to obstacles.

obstacles.name: Obstacles
obstacles.desc: Use either solids or custom objects as obstacles.

max-speed.name: Max speed
max-speed.desc: For movement, the maximum speed in pixels per second.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: For movement, the acceleration in pixels per second per second.

deceleration.name: Deceleration
deceleration.desc: For movement, the deceleration in pixels per second per second.

rotate-speed.name: Rotate speed
rotate-speed.desc: For movement, the maximum turn speed in degrees per second.

rotate-object.name: Rotate object
rotate-object.desc: For movement, whether to change the object's angle.

diagonals.name: Diagonals
diagonals.desc: Whether paths are allowed to use diagonal directions.

direct-movement.name: Direct movement
direct-movement.desc: Where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.
